title: All six stacking positions
description: Fires one toast per screen edge/corner, showing that the stacking math handles every position the same way.

title: Custom theme colors
description: Every ToastTheme field at once - background, text, details background, action color, and even the normally auto-computed close-icon color.

title: Gradient accent colors
description: ToastColor.gradient()/radialGradient()/conicGradient() build a CSS gradient string from two or more colors, usable anywhere a plain color string is - shown across the default, prominent, close-corner, and accent-top looks so you can see how each layout carries a gradient.

title: Multilingual out of the box
description: configure({ locale: 'de' }) switches the library's own chrome text - Details/Close/Confirm labels - live, without touching your own message/title strings.

title: Icons, from built-in to custom
description: A built-in severity icon with an entrance animation, a hand-built DOM Node as an icon, and toasts.promise() automatically swapping in a spinner/success/error icon via configure({ promiseIcons: true }).

title: Layouts & modifiers
description: The prominent named layout, plus stacking wide + stacked-actions modifiers directly for a custom look with no CSS.

title: Confirm before acting
description: Each step of the confirm flow gets its own color and message: confirm, a pending state while the (simulated) delete runs, then a success flash that closes the toast instead of reverting.

title: Confirm + live progress bar
description: Combines confirmButton() with progress: { mode: 'manual' } - onConfirm reports real progress via setToastProgress(id, value) instead of the bar just tracking a duration.

title: Multi-step buttons
description: The general-purpose state machine behind detailsCopyButton(), walking through your own custom steps.

title: Expandable, copyable details
description: A ToastDetailItem with its own label and a one-click Copy button via detailsCopyButton(), not just a plain line of text.

title: Progress bar
description: A thin progress bar synced to the toast's auto-dismiss countdown, with an onClose that only fires the follow-up toast on a real timeout.

title: Timers you control
description: Pause, resume, or extend a toast's auto-dismiss countdown from its own buttons - pauseToastTimer(), resumeToastTimer(), extendToastTimer().

title: Update without a full re-render
description: addToastDetail()/addToastButton() append to an already-visible toast piece by piece, instead of re-declaring the whole thing on every updateToast().

title: Bulk actions & grouping
description: Tag several toasts with the same source, then dismiss the whole group at once via clearBySource() - no manual id tracking needed.

title: React to toast lifecycle events
description: toasts.on('close', ...) subscribes to every toast's close event from one place, independent of any single toast's own onClose.

title: Promise-based toast
description: toasts.promise() shows a sticky loading toast, then patches it to a success or error message (and color) once the promise settles - no manual updateToast() bookkeeping needed. Each outcome picks its own transition: a fade on success, a shake on error.

title: Play a transition on demand
description: playToastTransition(id, transition) plays a transition with no content change - e.g. shaking a toast to signal a disallowed action instead of dismissing it.

title: Reverse stacking order
description: Insert a toast at the far end of the stack instead of nearest the anchor edge.

title: Rich HTML content
description: Opt into HTML rendering for the message when plain text isn't enough.

title: Boss fight
description: A more complex example combining multiple features
